title: Lenovo Recalls ThinkCentre Desktop Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A defect in an internal component in the power supply can overheat and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 50,500.

title: Umbro Boys' Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled; Waist Drawstrings Pose Entrapment Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Ross Stores
summary: The boys' jacket has a retractable elastic drawstring at the waist with a toggle that could become snagged or caught in small spaces or doorways, which poses an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 240.

title: Locker Brand Recalls Rx Lockers Due to Failure Leading to Allowing Unauthorized Access to Medicine Containers
summary: The medicine container can open by applying pressure to the latch when it is locked. This could result in unauthorized access to medicine bottles in the container. Units: About 59,600.

title: Swing Sets Recalled for Repair by BCI Burke Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The welded connection of the sleeve joint to the arch support can crack or break. When this happens, the top swing beam can collapse causing children on the swings to fall and be injured. Units: About 250.

title: Gore Recalls Ride-On Bicycle Brake Cables Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When the brake cables are installed on Campagnolo® style brake levers, they can detach, causing the brakes to fail and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 9,700 in the United States and about 200 in Canada.

title: LED Night Lights Recalled by AmerTac Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: An electrical short circuit in the night light can cause it to overheat and smolder or melt, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 227,000.

title: Adjustable Mattress Bases Recalled by Leggett & Platt Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical components in the motor control board can fail and short causing overheating, which poses a fire hazard. Units: About 25,200.

title: Lacrosse Helmets Recalled by Easton Sports Due to Facial Injury Hazard
summary: The chin bar can break, causing the wearer to suffer a jaw or facial injury. Units: About 12,000.

title: Safety 1st Cabinet Locks Recalled Due to Lock Failure; Children Can Gain Unintended Access to Dangerous Items
summary: Young children can disengage the cabinet locks, allowing access to cabinet contents and posing the risk of injury, due to dangerous or unsafe items. Units: About 900,000.

title: Ceiling Fans Recalled by Westinghouse Lighting Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The two 60-watt light bulbs included with the ceiling fans exceed the fan's maximum wattage, which can cause the ceiling fans to overheat or fail. This poses fire and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 7,000.

title: Bon Hiver Recalls Freebase Snowboard Bindings Due To Fall Hazard
summary: The binding's base plate can fracture from impact during use, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders. Units: About 200.

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Utility Vehicles due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tube can scrape against the air cleaner housing and develop holes, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,900.

title: Guidecraft Recalls Children's Play Theaters Due to Tip-over Hazard
summary: The recalled children's toys can unexpectedly tip over during play, posing an entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 1,800 in the United States and 350 in Canada.

title: Hydrostatic Lawn Tractors Recalled by Hydro-Gear Due to Crash Hazard
summary: A drive gear in the lawn tractor's hydrostatic transaxle can fail causing brake failure, posing a crash hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,700.

title: Toy Truck Gifts with Purchase Recalled by Happy Shirts Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Connections in the toy trucks battery compartment can smolder or catch the trucks on fire, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,000.

title: Arena Lamp Recalled by Great American Opportunities Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The electrical design and construction of the lamps poses the risk of an electric shock to consumers. Units: About 14,050.

title: Baby Dolls Recalled by Lakeshore Learning Materials Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The fingers and toes of the dolls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,900 in the U.S., 400 in Canada.
